ladder.label: TOPPING

ladder.next: Trim or tighten stops; next likely support is the daily-cycle timing band (~day 36-42, now day 17).
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum positive; but rolling toward a weekly cross-down
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: MIXED — weekly momentum positive; but rolling toward a weekly cross-down (investor cycle week 25 · daily cycle day 17).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): topping. Bigger picture (no clear trend): mixed.
points: Bigger picture is mixed (no clear trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 17 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 17 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 25 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: late — the bigger cycle is getting old
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 25 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 晚期——更大的周期已趋于老化
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its SECOND half ('right-translated') — strong cycles top late, a healthy-uptrend sign.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在后半段见顶（“右移”）——强周期见顶偏晚，属于健康上涨趋势的信号。

ladder.why_zh: 日线动量刚刚向下交叉，且价格在周期中段失守 10 日均线。

ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：做顶中。大局（趋势不明）：混合。

ladder.liq_line: US net liquidity is neutral right now — no macro tilt either way on the odds.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ TOPPING signal triggered 2 trading days ago (~2026-06-10), switching from NEARING A LOW. Signal strength: moderate (score -40/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 做顶中信号于 2 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-10），自接近低点切换而来。 信号强度：中等（评分 -40/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：强卖出/离场形态（-61）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
